---
title: "Trait associations, everyone pooled"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
---

Which proteins, gene-set scores and module eigengenes follow muscle size and strength when every
person is pooled and each trait stays a number? No group label enters any model. Pooling avoids a
split, not confounding: a feature that tracks growth may track anything that travels with growth
across these 16 people, and HR and LR are extreme groups, so correlations across them run stronger
than they would across all 25 trained people.

Four analyses, each for three feature types (proteins, gene sets, modules):

- Sample model. Every T1 and T2 biopsy carries that person's trait values at that time. Per trait,
  limma fits feature ~ timepoint + between + within with person as a block, where `between` is the
  person's mean trait and `within` the biopsy's deviation from it. `within` asks whether a feature
  rises in the biopsies where that person's trait rose; `between` asks whether people with more of
  the trait carry more of the feature.
- Change score. One value per person per window (table below), against each trait: limma slope
  with its 95% interval, Spearman's rho with a Fisher-z interval, and the biweight midcorrelation
  (bicor), a correlation that down-weights outliers.
- Two predictor: feature ~ growth + strength gain, each slope adjusted for the other.
- Interaction: feature ~ growth × strength gain, asking whether the link to strength gain depends
  on how much the person grew.

| window | feature value | traits |
|---|---|---|
| `training` | change T1 → T2 | % change, composite, volume |
| `baseline` | T1 level | % change, composite, volume |
| `acute` | change T2 → T3 | % change, composite, volume |
| `baseline_level` | T1 level | trait levels at T1 |
| `post_level` | T2 level | trait levels at T2 |
| `post_bout_level` | T3 level | trait levels at T2 (T3 has no phenotype) |

BH and Storey's q run within each screen (and within collection for gene sets).

## Packages

```{r}
#| label: packages
#| message: false
library(here)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
source(here("00_Setup", "Shared_functions", "analysis_reporting_helpers.R"))
```

## The association helper

`associate_level()` runs the four analyses for one level and is called three times below. It takes
the feature-by-run matrix, the sample sheet, labels and display order; it draws the overview
heatmaps and the strongest p < 0.05 hits (at most 12 per page), and writes the level's workbook. It
returns the level's counts of tests and calls.

```{r}
#| label: associate-level
associate_level <- function(stage, name, inputs, paths, values, meta, feature_label, feature_noun,
                            feature_unit, value_label, row_groups, row_order,
                            collection_of = NULL, panel_name = \(label, collection) label,
                            observed_share = NULL, save_change_score = FALSE) {
  out <- file.path(stage, "c_data")
  dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  workbook <- paste0(name, ".xlsx")
  by_collection <- if (is.null(collection_of)) character(0) else "collection"
  labelled_heat <- \(...) make_report_heatmap(..., labels = feature_label)
  labelled <- function(d) {
    if (length(by_collection)) d <- mutate(d, collection = collection_of[feature], .after = feature)
    d <- mutate(d, label = feature_label[feature], .after = all_of(c("feature", by_collection)))
    if (is.null(observed_share)) {
      return(d)
    }
    mutate(d, observed_share = observed_share[feature], .after = label)
  }
  corrected <- function(d, ...) {
    mutate(d, fdr = p.adjust(p, "BH"), qvalue = storey_q(p), .by = c(..., all_of(by_collection)))
  }

  phenotype <- readr::read_csv(paths[["phenotype"]], show_col_types = FALSE)
  phenotype_list <- phenotype_tables(phenotype)
  traits <- phenotype_list$traits
  biopsy <- phenotype_list$biopsy
  pairing_tables <- phenotype_list$pairings
  pairing_outcomes <- map(pairing_tables, \(tt) setdiff(names(tt), "subject"))
  outcome_of <- \(name, subjects) pairing_value(pairing_tables, "training", name, subjects)

  samples <- meta |>
    filter(timepoint %in% c("T1", "T2")) |>
    select(sample_id, subject, timepoint) |>
    left_join(select(biopsy, -group), by = c("subject", "timepoint"))
  model <- map(set_names(traits), \(trait) {
    s <- samples |>
      filter(!is.na(.data[[trait]])) |>
      mutate(
        between = ave(.data[[trait]], subject),
        within = .data[[trait]] - between
      )
    design <- model.matrix(~ timepoint + between + within, s)
    y <- values[, s$sample_id]
    correlation <- duplicateCorrelation(y, design, block = s$subject)$consensus.correlation
    fit <- lmFit(y, design, block = s$subject, correlation = correlation) |>
      eBayes(robust = TRUE)
    map(c("within", "between"), \(term) {
      topTable(fit, coef = term, number = Inf, sort.by = "none", confint = TRUE) |>
        as_tibble(rownames = "feature") |>
        transmute(
          trait, term, feature,
          n_samples = nrow(s), slope = logFC, slope_lower = CI.L,
          slope_upper = CI.R, t, p = P.Value
        )
    }) |>
      list_rbind()
  }) |>
    list_rbind() |>
    labelled() |>
    corrected(trait, term)

  windows <- list(
    training = within_subject_change(values, meta, "T1", "T2"),
    baseline = values_at_timepoint(values, meta, "T1"),
    acute = within_subject_change(values, meta, "T2", "T3"),
    baseline_level = values_at_timepoint(values, meta, "T1"),
    post_level = values_at_timepoint(values, meta, "T2"),
    post_bout_level = values_at_timepoint(values, meta, "T3")
  )
  change_windows <- c("training", "baseline", "acute")
  linear <- \(x, outcome) fit_subject_model(x, data.frame(trait = outcome), ~trait, "trait")
  continuous <- function(x, outcome) {
    fit <- linear(x, outcome) |>
      select(
        feature, n_subjects,
        slope = estimate, slope_lower = estimate_lower, slope_upper = estimate_upper, t, p
      )
    ok <- !is.na(outcome)
    bc <- WGCNA::bicorAndPvalue(t(x[fit$feature, ok, drop = FALSE]), outcome[ok])
    rank <- spearman_by_row(x, outcome) |> select(feature, rho, rho_lower, rho_upper, p_rho = p)
    fit |>
      left_join(rank, by = "feature") |>
      mutate(bicor = bc$bicor[feature, 1], p_bicor = bc$p[feature, 1])
  }
  change_score <- imap(windows, \(x, window) {
    map(set_names(pairing_outcomes[[window]]), \(name) {
      continuous(x, pairing_value(pairing_tables, window, name, colnames(x)))
    }) |>
      list_rbind(names_to = "trait") |>
      mutate(window = window, .before = 1)
  }) |>
    list_rbind() |>
    labelled() |>
    corrected(window, trait)
  strength_tests <- c("pct_leg_press_1rm", "pct_leg_ext_1rm")
  two_predictor <- imap(windows[change_windows], \(x, window) {
    map(set_names(strength_tests), \(test) {
      predictors <- data.frame(
        growth = outcome_of("comp_hypertrophy", colnames(x)),
        strength = outcome_of(test, colnames(x))
      )
      fit_subject_model(x, predictors, ~ growth + strength, c("growth", "strength")) |>
        rename(slope = estimate, slope_lower = estimate_lower, slope_upper = estimate_upper)
    }) |>
      list_rbind(names_to = "strength_test") |>
      mutate(window = window, .before = 1)
  }) |>
    list_rbind() |>
    mutate(
      trait = if_else(coefficient == "growth", "comp_hypertrophy", strength_test),
      .after = coefficient
    ) |>
    labelled() |>
    corrected(window, strength_test, coefficient)

  interaction <- imap(windows[change_windows], \(x, window) {
    map(set_names(strength_tests), \(test) {
      predictors <- data.frame(
        growth = outcome_of("comp_hypertrophy", colnames(x)),
        strength = outcome_of(test, colnames(x))
      )
      fit_subject_model(x, predictors, ~ growth * strength, "growth:strength") |>
        rename(
          interaction = estimate, interaction_lower = estimate_lower,
          interaction_upper = estimate_upper
        )
    }) |>
      list_rbind(names_to = "strength_test") |>
      mutate(window = window, .before = 1)
  }) |>
    list_rbind() |>
    select(-coefficient) |>
    labelled() |>
    corrected(window, strength_test)

  tally <- function(d, ...) {
    summarise(d,
      n_tested = sum(!is.na(p)), n_nominal = sum(p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_fdr_05 = sum(fdr < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(..., all_of(by_collection))
    )
  }
  counts <- bind_rows(
    tally(model, term, trait) |>
      transmute(
        analysis = paste("model:", term), comparison = trait, pick(all_of(by_collection)),
        n_tested, n_nominal, n_fdr_05
      ),
    tally(change_score, window, trait) |>
      transmute(
        analysis = paste("change score:", window), comparison = trait,
        pick(all_of(by_collection)), n_tested, n_nominal, n_fdr_05
      ),
    tally(two_predictor, window, strength_test, coefficient) |>
      transmute(
        analysis = paste("two predictor:", window),
        comparison = paste(coefficient, strength_test, sep = ", "), pick(all_of(by_collection)),
        n_tested, n_nominal, n_fdr_05
      ),
    tally(interaction, window, strength_test) |>
      transmute(
        analysis = paste("interaction:", window), comparison = strength_test,
        pick(all_of(by_collection)), n_tested, n_nominal, n_fdr_05
      )
  )

  unit_cols <- grep("_pre_", names(phenotype), value = TRUE)
  unit_of <- set_names(sub(".*_pre_", "", unit_cols), sub("_pre_.*", "", unit_cols))
  outcome_unit <- c(
    comp_hypertrophy = "score", volume_load_total_kg = "kg",
    set_names(rep("%", length(traits)), paste0("pct_", traits)), unit_of[traits]
  )
  window_axis <- c(
    training = "change, T1 to T2", baseline = "T1 level", acute = "change, T2 to T3",
    baseline_level = "T1 level", post_level = "T2 level", post_bout_level = "T3 level"
  )
  bh_scope <- if (length(by_collection)) " and collection" else ""
  name_of <- \(d) panel_name(d$label, d[["collection"]])

  t_limit <- cap(model$t)
  overviews <- imap(row_groups, \(rows, group) {
    term_grid <- \(term, value) {
      results_to_matrix(filter(model, term == .env$term), rows, traits, "trait", value)
    }
    model_maps <- labelled_heat(
      term_grid("within", \(d) d$t), "Within-person t", c(-t_limit, 0, t_limit),
      "t"
    ) +
      labelled_heat(
        term_grid("between", \(d) d$t), "Between-person t", c(-t_limit, 0, t_limit), NULL
      ) +
      labelled_heat(term_grid("within", \(d) status_of(d$p, d$fdr)), "Within: p and BH q") +
      labelled_heat(term_grid("between", \(d) status_of(d$p, d$fdr)), "Between: p and BH q",
        row_names = TRUE
      )
    model_page <- heatmap_page(model_maps, sprintf("Sample model overview: %s", group), paste(
      sprintf("All %s %s, one row each.", format(length(rows), big.mark = ","), feature_noun),
      "Moderated t of the within and between terms, abundance ~ timepoint + between + within,",
      sprintf("subject blocked. Colours stop at the 99th percentile of |t|, %.2g.", t_limit),
      row_order, paste0("Grey: not tested. Table: c_data/", workbook, ", model.")
    ))
    window_pages <- map(names(windows), \(w) {
      d <- filter(change_score, window == w)
      maps <- labelled_heat(
        results_to_matrix(d, rows, pairing_outcomes[[w]], "trait", \(d) d$rho),
        "Spearman rho, both groups pooled", c(-1, 0, 1), "rho"
      ) +
        labelled_heat(
          results_to_matrix(d, rows, pairing_outcomes[[w]], "trait", \(d) status_of(d$p, d$fdr)),
          "limma p and BH q",
          row_names = TRUE
        )
      heatmap_page(maps, sprintf("Change score overview, %s window: %s", w, group), paste(
        sprintf("All %s %s, one row each.", format(length(rows), big.mark = ","), feature_noun),
        sprintf(
          "Spearman rho between the %s (%s) and each trait; status from limma.", value_label,
          window_axis[[w]]
        ),
        row_order, paste0("Grey: not tested. Table: c_data/", workbook, ", change_score.")
      ))
    })
    c(list(model_page), window_pages)
  }) |>
    list_flatten()

  trait_samples <- map(set_names(traits), \(trait) filter(samples, !is.na(.data[[trait]])))
  seen_in <- \(feature, trait) !is.na(values[feature, trait_samples[[trait]]$sample_id])
  model_hits <- model |>
    filter(p < 0.05) |>
    mutate(
      n_biopsies = map2_int(feature, trait, \(f, tr) sum(seen_in(f, tr))),
      n_subjects = map2_int(feature, trait, \(f, tr) {
        n_distinct(trait_samples[[tr]]$subject[seen_in(f, tr)])
      }),
      name = name_of(pick(everything())),
      panel = sprintf(
        "%s\n%s %.3g  p %.2g  q %.2g\n%d biopsies, %d subjects", name, term, slope, p, fdr,
        n_biopsies, n_subjects
      )
    ) |>
    arrange(match(trait, traits), desc(term), p, desc(abs(t)), feature) |>
    paginate_report_features(c("trait", "term"))
  model_scope <- if (length(by_collection)) "trait, term and collection," else "trait and term,"
  model_page <- function(hits) {
    trait <- hits$trait[1]
    term <- hits$term[1]
    info <- counts |>
      filter(analysis == paste("model:", term), comparison == trait) |>
      summarise(across(c(n_tested, n_nominal, n_fdr_05), sum))
    points <- hits |>
      select(feature, panel) |>
      cross_join(select(samples, sample_id, subject, timepoint, trait_value = all_of(trait))) |>
      mutate(
        value = values[cbind(feature, sample_id)],
        panel = factor(panel, slots(hits$panel))
      ) |>
      filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(trait_value))
    ggplot(points, aes(trait_value, value)) +
      geom_line(
        aes(group = subject),
        data = \(d) filter(d, n() == 2, .by = c(panel, subject)), alpha = 0.6, colour = "grey40"
      ) +
      geom_point(aes(shape = timepoint), size = 1.5) +
      facet_wrap(~panel, nrow = 3, ncol = 4, scales = "free", drop = FALSE) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c(T1 = 1, T2 = 16), name = NULL) +
      labs(
        title = sprintf("%s, %s-person term", trait, term),
        subtitle = counts_line(info, feature_noun, hits),
        x = sprintf("%s at the biopsy (%s)", trait, unit_of[[trait]]), y = value_label,
        caption = stringr::str_wrap(width = 160, paste(
          "limma, abundance ~ timepoint + between + within, subject blocked, on the T1 and T2",
          "biopsies with the trait measured. Lines join each subject's two biopsies: the within",
          "term reads their slopes, the between term the spread of subjects. Header: slope per",
          "trait unit, p, BH q within", model_scope,
          "and the biopsies and subjects where the feature was observed.",
          paste0("Table: c_data/", workbook, ", model.")
        ))
      ) +
      page_theme
  }

  change_hits <- change_score |>
    filter(p < 0.05) |>
    mutate(
      name = name_of(pick(everything())),
      panel = sprintf(
        "%s vs %s (%s)\nrho %+.2f  p %.2g  q %.2g  n %d", name, trait, outcome_unit[trait],
        rho, p, fdr, n_subjects
      )
    ) |>
    arrange(match(window, names(windows)), p, desc(abs(rho)), feature, trait) |>
    paginate_report_features("window")
  page_captions <- c(
    "change score" = paste(
      "One point per subject, every subject pooled. The line is a least-squares fit, drawn as a",
      "guide. Header: Spearman rho, and limma p and BH q within window, trait%s, with the",
      paste0("subjects used. Table: c_data/", workbook, ", change_score.")
    ),
    "two predictor" = paste(
      "One point per subject. Header: the growth or strength coefficient from limma, feature ~",
      "comp_hypertrophy + strength gain, each adjusted for the other, with p, BH q within",
      "window, strength test, term%s, and the subjects used. The x axis shows the term's own",
      "trait; the drawing does not hold the other predictor fixed.",
      paste0("Table: c_data/", workbook, ", two_predictor.")
    )
  )
  page_captions[] <- sprintf(page_captions, bh_scope)
  change_page <- function(hits, kind = "change score") {
    w <- hits$window[1]
    info <- counts |>
      filter(analysis == paste0(kind, ": ", w)) |>
      summarise(across(c(n_tested, n_nominal, n_fdr_05), sum))
    points <- hits |>
      select(feature, trait, panel) |>
      cross_join(tibble(subject = colnames(windows[[w]]))) |>
      mutate(
        value = windows[[w]][cbind(feature, subject)],
        trait_value = map2_dbl(trait, subject, \(o, s) pairing_value(pairing_tables, w, o, s)),
        panel = factor(panel, slots(hits$panel))
      ) |>
      filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(trait_value))
    ggplot(points, aes(value, trait_value)) +
      # A straight line needs two points, not the default 80.
      geom_smooth(
        method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5, n = 2, colour = "grey40"
      ) +
      geom_point(size = 1.3) +
      facet_wrap(~panel, nrow = 3, ncol = 4, scales = "free", drop = FALSE) +
      labs(
        title = sprintf("%s, %s window", stringr::str_to_sentence(kind), w),
        subtitle = counts_line(info, "feature-trait pairs", hits),
        x = sprintf("%s, %s", value_label, window_axis[[w]]), y = "trait (unit in header)",
        caption = stringr::str_wrap(page_captions[[kind]], 160)
      ) +
      page_theme
  }
  model_pages <- map(split(model_hits, model_hits$pdf_page), model_page)
  change_pages <- map(split(change_hits, change_hits$pdf_page), change_page)
  slope_hits <- two_predictor |>
    filter(p < 0.05) |>
    mutate(
      kind = "two predictor",
      header = sprintf(
        "%s term, %s model %+.3g", coefficient, sub("pct_", "", strength_test), slope
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(
      name = name_of(pick(everything())),
      panel = sprintf(
        "%s vs %s (%s)\n%s  p %.2g  q %.2g  n %d", name, trait, outcome_unit[trait], header,
        p, fdr, n_subjects
      )
    ) |>
    arrange(match(window, names(windows)), p, desc(abs(t)), feature, trait) |>
    paginate_report_features(c("kind", "window"))
  slope_pages <- map(split(slope_hits, slope_hits$pdf_page), \(hits) {
    change_page(hits, hits$kind[1])
  })

  plot_index <- bind_rows(
    tibble(
      analysis = "overview", label = map_chr(overviews, "title"), pdf_page = seq_along(overviews)
    ),
    transmute(model_hits,
      analysis = "model", trait, term, pick(all_of(by_collection)), feature, label,
      pdf_page = pdf_page + length(overviews), position
    ),
    transmute(change_hits,
      analysis = "change score", window, trait, pick(all_of(by_collection)), feature, label,
      pdf_page = pdf_page + length(overviews) + length(model_pages), position
    ),
    transmute(slope_hits,
      analysis = kind, window, trait, strength_test, coefficient, pick(all_of(by_collection)),
      feature, label,
      pdf_page = pdf_page + length(overviews) + length(model_pages) + length(change_pages),
      position
    )
  )
  stopifnot(
    nrow(model_hits) == capped_count(filter(model, p < 0.05), c("trait", "term")),
    nrow(change_hits) == capped_count(filter(change_score, p < 0.05), "window"),
    !anyDuplicated(select(filter(plot_index, !is.na(feature)), -label, -pdf_page, -position)),
    nrow(slope_hits) == capped_count(filter(two_predictor, p < 0.05), "window"),
    max(plot_index$pdf_page) ==
      length(overviews) + length(model_pages) + length(change_pages) + length(slope_pages)
  )

  if (save_change_score) {
    saveRDS(list(change_score = change_score), file.path(out, "associate.rds"), compress = "xz")
  }

  walk(overviews, \(page) page$draw())
  walk(c(model_pages, change_pages, slope_pages), print)

  write_workbook(
    list(
      counts = counts, model = arrange(model, trait, term, p),
      change_score = arrange(change_score, window, trait, p),
      two_predictor = arrange(two_predictor, window, strength_test, coefficient, p),
      interaction = arrange(interaction, window, strength_test, p),
      plot_index = plot_index
    ),
    c(
      "Tested, p < 0.05 and BH < 0.05 counts per term and trait, and per window and trait.",
      sprintf(paste(
        "Sample model: slope per trait unit with its 95%% CI, t, p, BH and Storey q per %s, trait",
        "and term."
      ), feature_unit),
      sprintf(paste(
        "Change score, every subject pooled: limma slope with its 95%% CI, t, p, BH, Storey q;",
        "Spearman rho with its Fisher-z 95%% CI and p_rho; bicor and its p; per %s, window",
        "and trait."
      ), feature_unit),
      sprintf(paste(
        "Two predictor: growth and strength slopes with 95%% CIs, t, p, BH and Storey q per %s,",
        "window and test."
      ), feature_unit),
      sprintf(paste(
        "Interaction, feature ~ growth x strength gain: interaction term with its 95%% CI, t, p,",
        "BH and Storey q per %s, window and test."
      ), feature_unit),
      "PDF page of each overview, and page and panel position of every p < 0.05 row."
    ),
    file.path(out, workbook),
    inputs, paths
  )
  counts
}
```

## Proteins

Rank tests and correlations take no covariate, so proteins come from limpa's blood-corrected
matrix; `observed_share` records how much of each protein was measured rather than estimated. The
protein change scores are also saved to `associate.rds` for `02_Trait_Pathways`.

```{r}
#| label: fig-proteins
#| fig-cap: "Proteins: overviews, then the strongest p < 0.05 hits per analysis."
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 8.5
inputs <- c(
  corrected = "01_Processing/03_Quantification/c_data/DAList_corrected.rds",
  limpa = "01_Processing/03_Quantification/c_data/DAList_limpa.rds",
  phenotype = "00_Setup/Input/phenotype.csv"
)
paths <- map_chr(inputs, here)
stopifnot(file.exists(paths))
dal <- readRDS(paths[["corrected"]])
feature_label <- with(dal$annotation, set_names(gene, uniprot_id))
stopifnot(!anyNA(feature_label), !anyDuplicated(feature_label))
complete <- readRDS(paths[["limpa"]])$data
protein_counts <- associate_level(
  stage = here("04_Continuous_no_group", "01_Trait_Associations", "01_Proteins"),
  name = "protein_trait_associations", inputs = inputs, paths = paths,
  values = dal$data, observed_share = rowMeans(dal$observed), meta = as_tibble(dal$metadata),
  feature_label = feature_label, feature_noun = "proteins", feature_unit = "protein",
  value_label = "log2 abundance",
  row_groups = list(
    proteins = rownames(complete)[hclust(as.dist(1 - cor(t(complete))), "average")$order]
  ),
  row_order = "Rows: average-linkage clustering of limpa's matrix, for display only.",
  save_change_score = TRUE
)
```

## Gene sets

Each set's singscore per run; each collection is its own screen.

```{r}
#| label: fig-sets
#| fig-cap: "Gene sets: overviews by collection, then the strongest p < 0.05 hits."
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 8.5
inputs <- c(
  singscore = "01_Processing/05_Set_Scores/c_data/singscore.rds",
  gene_sets = "01_Processing/04_Gene_Sets/c_data/gene_sets.rds",
  proteins = "01_Processing/03_Quantification/c_data/DAList_corrected.rds",
  phenotype = "00_Setup/Input/phenotype.csv"
)
paths <- map_chr(inputs, here)
stopifnot(file.exists(paths))
catalog <- readRDS(paths[["gene_sets"]])$set_catalog |> filter(qualifies)
values <- readRDS(paths[["singscore"]])$scores[catalog$set_id, ]
meta <- as_tibble(readRDS(paths[["proteins"]])$metadata)
stopifnot(identical(colnames(values), meta$sample_id))
set_counts <- associate_level(
  stage = here("04_Continuous_no_group", "01_Trait_Associations", "02_Sets"),
  name = "set_trait_associations", inputs = inputs, paths = paths,
  values = values, meta = meta,
  feature_label = with(catalog, set_names(enrichVolcano::ev_clean_label(pathway), set_id)),
  feature_noun = "sets", feature_unit = "set", value_label = "singscore",
  row_groups = split(catalog$set_id, factor(catalog$collection, unique(catalog$collection))) |>
    map(\(ids) ids[hclust(as.dist(1 - cor(t(values[ids, ]))), "average")$order]),
  row_order = "Rows: average-linkage clustering of singscore within collection, display only.",
  collection_of = with(catalog, set_names(collection, set_id)),
  panel_name = \(label, collection) {
    paste0(collection, ": ", stringr::str_wrap(gsub("\n", " ", label), 50))
  }
)
```

## Modules

```{r}
#| label: fig-modules
#| fig-cap: "Modules: overviews, then the strongest p < 0.05 hits."
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 8.5
inputs <- c(
  modules = "01_Processing/06_Module_Building/c_data/modules.rds",
  phenotype = "00_Setup/Input/phenotype.csv"
)
paths <- map_chr(inputs, here)
stopifnot(file.exists(paths))
modules <- readRDS(paths[["modules"]])
values <- modules$eigengenes
meta <- as_tibble(modules$meta)
stopifnot(identical(colnames(values), meta$sample_id))
module_counts <- associate_level(
  stage = here("04_Continuous_no_group", "01_Trait_Associations", "03_Modules"),
  name = "module_trait_associations", inputs = inputs, paths = paths,
  values = values, meta = meta, feature_label = set_names(rownames(values)),
  feature_noun = "modules", feature_unit = "module", value_label = "eigengene",
  row_groups = list(modules = modules$module_summary$module),
  row_order = "Rows follow module size."
)
```

## Summary

Tests and calls per analysis and level, summed over traits and windows:

```{r}
#| label: summary
bind_rows(
  proteins = protein_counts, sets = set_counts, modules = module_counts, .id = "feature_type"
) |>
  mutate(analysis = sub(":.*", "", analysis)) |>
  summarise(across(c(n_tested, n_nominal, n_fdr_05), sum), .by = c(feature_type, analysis))
```
